doc.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Miles from India, Nomads, Saxophone Summit and Manhattan School orchestra dates
summary: Brief comments on Bob Belden's project, the Michael Stephans duo, the Saxophone Summit albums and the Miles Ahead and Sketches of Spain orchestra concerts.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Here’s Bob Belden’s project, Miles from India, with a cast of thousands.
What did you do on that?
I played flute. I actually brought the flute out, and I think I played soprano on something. That was a mess. I love Bob, but he’s a little loose sometimes.
Well, that’s part of his charm.
Sometimes it works. Sometimes it doesn’t.
Here’s a duo record with Michael Stephans, the drummer.
Yes, Nomads, up at (W)VIA. Found a German label. They’re the same label that released the Ornette record that we won the award for.
It’s Jazzwerkstatt. No, it’s ITM. It’s the other division of Jazzwerkstatt. That’s right.
We have a bunch of dates for Saxophone Summit.
Two, Gathering of Spirits and Seraphic Light, those two I talked to you about.
Last, the dates – the ensemble dates with the Manhattan School of Music Orchestra.
I heard one of those. It sounded wonderful.

That was a real challenge, to step into those shoes. And I liked the Sketches in Europe. I got a guy there. We’re doing it in April. In Linz I’m doing it. Linz opera house. I found a guy. He gets students. He rehearses them. I use a rhythm section from there.
